name: Old Walled City of Shibam
description: Rising from the floor of Wadi Hadhramaut in eastern Yemen, Shibam is a walled town of mudbrick skyscrapers, some as tall as eleven storeys, packed tightly together. Most of the present city dates from the 16th century, and people have lived here for roughly 1,700 years. The dense towers earned it the nickname "Manhattan of the Desert." The site is now listed as in danger.
